title: BitLocker recovery passwords are never rotated

report.title: {Items.Count} encryption {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy never rotates', 'policies never rotate')} recovery passwords

messages.businessImpact: A recovery password stays valid after it has been read out. Anybody who was given one, a departing employee or whoever was standing at the service desk, can still unlock that device, and there is no record that they can.
remediation: Switch recovery password rotation on for Entra joined devices, and for registered devices as well where the estate has them.
Rotation happens after a key is used, so nothing changes on devices whose keys nobody has needed.
messages.cannotSee: Whether rotation is configured is read, not whether a key has ever been used. An object that leaves rotation alone is not reported here even though the result on a device is the same; SEC-032 reports a tenant where no assigned policy switches rotation on. A BitLocker setting is read wherever it sits, whether that is an endpoint security policy, a security baseline, a Settings Catalog profile or an Endpoint Protection template profile, and the report names which. An object that says nothing about this setting is not reported for it, because saying nothing and switching it off are different things and only the second is a finding.
